title: 2026-11-14 manually reviewed Research Park primary-source company descriptions
policy: Publish only if company id and exact Research Park profile URL match existing record; insert immutable description claim with source and supporting evidence; do not infer financing, growth, or endorsement.
excluded: second-chance-innovations: official listing describes program participation only, not product

records.name: AI Nexus Healthcare
records.description: Develops AI-powered health and wellness applications, including tools intended to help users and care teams recognize early health risks.
records.evidence_note: Research Park describes its cognitive AI health applications and mia early-warning platform.

records.name: AmnioAlert
records.description: Develops a disposable liner intended to detect amniotic fluid at home and help identify the onset of labor.
records.evidence_note: Research Park describes the disposable amniotic-fluid detection liner and its purpose.

records.name: BlooMD
records.description: Researches plant-derived bioactive compounds and screens plant materials for activity against fungal and bacterial pathogens.

records.name: Boston Bioprocess

records.name: Cache Energy

records.evidence_note: Research Park describes thermal-based long-duration energy storage and industrial applications.

records.name: Eleuthra Photonics

records.name: Epivara

records.name: EPL Power Electronics, Inc.

records.name: HabiTerre
